taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: The occurrence satisfies VIGIL-FC-000038 Required Control Non-Activation. City policy required disclosure for AI-generated material; the flyer was AI-generated, the disclosure control was therefore applicable, the required disclosure was absent, and the material nevertheless proceeded through the public-communications workflow to distribution. The classification is limited to the disclosure-control failure and does not infer a separate copyright, provenance or police trust-chain mechanism.

primary_classification.classification_basis: A defined city AI-disclosure control was applicable to the AI-generated flyer, but the required disclosure did not activate before the flyer was publicly distributed.
